text.en:
On Anu's street, neighbours celebrate Pongal, Eid, Christmas and Diwali, and share sweets with each other.
"Every festival is everyone's festival," said her grandmother.

India is home to many languages, religions, foods, dresses and festivals. The Constitution lists 22 languages, and hundreds of others are spoken. People of many faiths live here, and they celebrate different festivals.
Our diversity is the result of geography and history. People came to India, settled and mixed over thousands of years. They shared food, music, art and ideas.
Unity in diversity means different people living together as one nation, respecting each other. Our Constitution gives all citizens equal rights, and festivals and sports bring us together.
India has many languages, religions, foods and festivals.
People came, settled and mixed over centuries.
Unity in diversity means living together as one nation.
The Constitution gives equal rights to all citizens.

problem.en: How can we show respect for diversity at school?

text.en: Listen to classmates who speak other languages.
Share and enjoy each other's festivals.
Never make fun of anyone's food, dress or faith.

prompt.en: A friend says differences make a country weak. How will you reply?

points.en: India has many languages, faiths, foods and festivals.
Diversity grew out of geography and history.
Unity in diversity means respect for all.
